item.description: The base NotifyBase class has issues with URL parsing and parameter handling, particularly in the parse_url method. The URL parsing logic fails to correctly handle parameters like 'format' and 'overflow' when they contain invalid values, causing test failures in test_notify_base_urls.
item.contract: The parse_url method should properly validate and filter out invalid parameters like 'format' and 'overflow' instead of allowing them to remain in the results dictionary when they are invalid. Valid parameters should be preserved and invalid ones removed from the returned dictionary.

item.description: The base NotifyBase class doesn't properly handle plugin instantiation when plugins are disabled. The instantiate method in Apprise class should correctly filter out disabled plugins and return None for disabled plugin instances.
item.contract: The instantiate method should check if a plugin is disabled (enabled=False) and return None instead of creating an instance. This should happen before attempting to create the plugin object.

item.description: The base NotifyBase class incorrectly handles URL parameter validation for format and overflow parameters. When invalid values are passed, they should be stripped from the results rather than being left in the dictionary.
item.contract: When parse_url processes format and overflow parameters, it should validate that the values are in the allowed set (NOTIFY_FORMATS, OVERFLOW_MODES) and remove them from results if invalid. Only valid values should remain in the returned dictionary.

item.description: The base NotifyBase class has incomplete URL parameter handling in the url_parameters method. The method doesn't properly handle cases where parameters like 'format' and 'overflow' are not present in the instance, causing inconsistencies in URL generation.
item.contract: The url_parameters method should ensure consistent handling of optional parameters. If parameters like 'format' and 'overflow' are not explicitly set, they should not appear in the returned parameters dictionary to avoid unnecessary clutter in URLs.

item.description: There's an inconsistency in URL parsing handling between the base class and plugin-specific implementations. Some plugins don't properly inherit or override the base URL parsing behavior, leading to test failures in URL parsing tests.
item.contract: Plugins should properly inherit URL parsing behavior from NotifyBase and handle parameter validation consistently. The url_to_dict function should correctly process URLs and return properly validated results without leaving invalid parameters in the returned dictionary.
